what: Kraft Heinz makes packaged food: Heinz ketchup, Kraft cheese and macaroni, Oscar Mayer, Philadelphia, Capri Sun and Lunchables. It is preparing to split into two companies.
customers: Supermarkets, club stores, restaurants and food service distributors, mostly in North America.
money: Heinz and other brands outside North America
moat: Brands that have been in household cupboards for generations, with shelf space and scale in manufacturing, though the moat has visibly narrowed.
risks: It reported a very large loss after writing down the value of its brands
Revenue has fallen about 2% a year over three years as volumes decline
Consumers have shifted toward fresh food and cheaper own-brand products
opportunities: Splitting the company would separate the growing sauces business from the declining grocery brands
Gross margin of 33% still leaves room for cost reduction
watch: Organic volume trends and the terms and timing of the planned separation.
